verdict.rationale: Statsig documents an access-management layer with SSO and SCIM for team/user provisioning, implying some enterprise access controls, but there is no explicit documentation of fine-grained roles/permissions for who can change specific flags, nor of scoped/limited API tokens for flag management. missing for 10: explicit RBAC/permission model for flag changes, documentation of scoped API tokens restricting write access to specific gates/experiments, and any audit trail tying role restrictions to flag mutations.
